Fixed and committed as `57835f1`, "Count retried payments once in nightly reconciliation".

The nightly job counted each payment row, so a bank retry carrying the same payment id was counted twice. Both nightly jobs had this logic, so I fixed both:

- `src/orders-service-v1/nightly_job.py`: `run_nightly_job` now counts distinct payment ids that match no order.
- `src/orders-api/reconciliation_worker.py`: `ReconciliationWorker.run` does the same. Its docstring says it also runs nightly. If you only meant `nightly_job.py`, drop this file from the commit.

I added a regression test to each suite for a retried payment. Both new tests fail on the old code and pass with the fix. The full suite passes (10 tests).

I left the existing uncommitted `README.md` edit and the untracked `notes/` directory out of the commit.
